units.source_text: 柏木说着，费了好大的劲儿才站了起来，仿佛身体一度散了架又重新组合似的。

en.t: As Kashiwagi said this, he managed to stand up only with great effort, as though his body had once fallen apart and then been assembled again.

units.source_text: 它使我联想起电影里所看到的骆驼的起居。

en.t: It reminded me of the way camels rise and settle down, as I had seen in films.
